name: shape_classifier_s2
type: exploratory modelling build on the tick archive; not a phase
branch: explore/shape-classifier-s2, cut from master at dd208be (master contains the brief's base b526ab6 through the Cooper-requested merge a9ed1eb, plus the CLAUDE.md git-rule change 9b82db3 and the E2 units fix; cut from master so the current CLAUDE.md governs)

population.label: S1 theory type at N = 100 (s1_theory_types.parquet, type_state = typed); unlabelled events carried in counts, never fitted or scored
population.secondary_labels: S1 theory types at N = 50 and N = 200: scored against the N = 100 models' probabilities, never fitted
population.excluded_from_every_fold: dev_group in {dev_v3, dev_v4_sidecar} (S1 s1_events.dev_group; 49 dev_v3 and 4 sidecar events carry tau in this population)

cooper_rulings_2026_09_28._note: Asked after measuring the brief's premises on disk before any build (AskUserQuestion, this session). Each ruling names the measurement it answered.

R1_tau_close_sensitive.measured: tau_close_sensitive (b1 A1.3: |tau(revised close) - tau(minute-bar close)| > 60 s) is not settled at tau for 3,585 of 15,519 events: the minute-bar-close crossing comes after tau for 3,302 and never happens for 283. It is settled by tau + 60 s for every event.
R1_tau_close_sensitive.ruling: causal 3-level input: at each decision time d the flag as far as it is settled by d -- TRUE / FALSE / not_settled
R1_tau_close_sensitive.rule: on exact print times: the minute-bar crossing print (recomputed in T2 with b1's first_crossing: 1.30 x the minute-bar close of results/relative_momentum/r0/artifacts/t0a2_prior_close.parquet, spike guard 3% / 3%) at or before d -> TRUE if |tau_exact - tau_mb_exact| > 60 s else FALSE; not at or before d -> TRUE if d - tau_d > 60 s else not_settled. Checked against b1's stored tau_ns_mb (within its 128 ns rounding)

R2_short_interest.measured: F1's si_asof_ns is the SETTLEMENT date (midnight UTC), not publication; settlement -> event date median 7 calendar days, 5% on the event date itself. No publication date on disk. Under an 8-session publication assumption only 2,104 of 15,107 events would use the settlement F1 used.
R2_short_interest.ruling: latest settlement whose assumed publication, 10 XNYS sessions after settlement (conservative; FINRA's actual lag not verifiable offline [verify]), is a session strictly before the event date
R2_short_interest.measured_effect: 14,803 events keep a value (F1: 15,107); median settlement 24 days before the event
R2_short_interest.latest_timestamp: 20:00 ET of the assumed publication session
R2_short_interest.f1_untouched: rebuilt here from the raw vendor files; data/fundamentals/event_fundamentals.parquet is not modified

R3_fundamentals_anchor.measured: F1 anchors at t0 (D28/D33); t0 > tau for 1,477 events. One event (LNSR_2024-11-07_31.57) carries a shares count accepted after tau; six events' F1 filing windows reach past tau (dilution flag FALSE for all six either way).
R3_fundamentals_anchor.ruling: re-anchor at tau with D28's rule: accepted_ns < tau (and, for shares, asof < tau as in F1's T5), from F1's own raw SEC archive
R3_fundamentals_anchor.shares_outstanding: dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding observations from companyfacts (research/fundamentals_f1/t4_shares_outstanding.py's extraction), accession -> acceptanceDateTime from the submissions archive; the observation with the latest accepted_ns among accepted_ns < tau and asof_ns < tau
R3_fundamentals_anchor.dilution_flag: research/fundamentals_f1/t3_filing_index.py's rule with tau as the anchor: any dilution form accepted in [tau - 72 h, tau), or the last form accepted before tau is a dilution form; form set = config/fundamentals_f1.json dilution_form_set (8-K counts when its items include 3.02)
R3_fundamentals_anchor.turnover: shares traded 04:00 -> tau (b2 shares_0400_tau) / the tau-anchored shares count, corrected by research/fundamental_exploration/common.py::add_corrected_shares_outstanding's rule (split strictly before tau after the count's as-of date)

R4_positive_control.measured: on S1's tables with the S2 folds (primary sets, HGB): + terminal_log gives runaway 0.94-0.95, burst 0.79-0.81, slow climb 0.89-0.92, exhausted 0.76-0.80, fade 0.85-0.88, chop 0.75-0.80 -- row 3 would fire because terminal return does not set the type. + the rule inputs gives 1.000 (HGB) and >= 0.993 (logistic) for every type and fold.
R4_positive_control.ruling: two positive-control runs on M2 and M3 at every decision time; row 3 gates on the rule-inputs leak (post100_rise_pct, post100_fall_pct, post100_u_peak); the briefed terminal_log run is reported beside it, ungated

R5_negative_control.measured: one shuffle per fold (HGB, 10 shuffles): runaway ranged 0.32-0.69 and fell outside 0.45-0.55 in 60% of fold cells (burst/slow climb/fade 17-20%, exhausted 10%, chop 0%); pooling folds biases runaway to 0.458 because base rates differ by fold
R5_negative_control.ruling: 10 independent shuffles per fold; row 2 reads the mean per-fold AUC over the 3 folds x 10 shuffles for each type x model x decision time against 0.45-0.55; hyperparameters fixed at the real run's choices; single-shuffle per-fold values reported beside it

declared_interpretations._note: Choices the brief leaves open, declared before the run.
declared_interpretations.not_reached: a checkpoint's decision exists only for events that reach it; reach status is known only at 20:00 (when the whole path, hence the label, is known), so it can never be an input. Each checkpoint's models are fitted and scored on events that reached it; not_reached and undefined events stay in every table with counts per fold x type x checkpoint
declared_interpretations.undefined_volume_checkpoint: tau in an auction minute has no segment start (Amendment 3), so the reference volume and the four volume checkpoints are 'undefined' for those events
declared_interpretations.wall_clock_past_2000: tau + x beyond 20:00 ET is not_reached
declared_interpretations.m0_per_checkpoint: M0 at checkpoint c = type shares among the training events that reached c
declared_interpretations.latency: brief's entry (next print strictly after the decision time) is primary and is the zero-latency upper bound (Phase 8 / D7 convention); CLAUDE.md / D5 require realistic latency, so entries at the first print at or after d + 1 s and d + 5 s (Phase 10e's tick latency grid) are reported beside it
declared_interpretations.class_weights: none and balanced are separate model variants for M2, M3 and M4, each tuned on its own; both reported. M4 balanced = neighbour votes weighted by 1 / training class share, renormalised
declared_interpretations.tuning_split: inside each fold's training window: sub-train = training years before the last one; validation = the last training year's events whose ticker is not in the sub-train years (mirrors the primary read). Refit on the whole training window with the chosen setting
declared_interpretations.hgb_early_stopping: off (sklearn turns it on by itself above 10,000 rows, which would override the declared iteration grid)
declared_interpretations.m2_encoding: numeric: training median fill + missing-indicator column for every input missing anywhere in training; booleans as 0/1 with the same; categoricals one-hot with a 'missing' level; StandardScaler; lbfgs multinomial, max_iter 3000
declared_interpretations.smoothing: M1 cell shares and M4 neighbour shares smoothed with one pseudo-event at M0's shares: (n_type + 1 * p0_type) / (n + 1), so log loss is finite
declared_interpretations.m1_cells: turnover band = training-fold quartiles of log10 turnover plus 'missing'; ignition True / False / missing; tau_anchor_segment (5 levels)
declared_interpretations.tau_rounding: d = tau_d = max(stored tau_ns, the crossing print's own timestamp). Every stored tau_ns in b1 / b2 / S1 is a multiple of 256 ns (float64-rounded upstream, error <= 128 ns either way; T0 measured it before the build); the crossing print = the earliest print at tau_price within 128 ns of the stored value. Inputs b2 / S1 built on the stored tau are then <= tau_d, the crossing print is <= tau_d, and entries (next print after d) are never the crossing print. Wall-clock and volume checkpoints count from tau_d
declared_interpretations.group_b_offsets: post_trades_per_min = (collapsed prints + 0.5) / elapsed minutes; post_dollars_per_min = (dollars + 1) / elapsed minutes (finite logs when nothing traded); elapsed floored at 1 s
declared_interpretations.group_b_transforms: log1p on max_gap_s and since_last_print_s; asinh on z_ret, z_high, z_dd, rv_ratio (monotone, so M3 is unaffected; keeps M2's standardisation finite)
declared_interpretations.sigma_pre_not_an_input: sigma_pre is the noise scale only; it is not itself a model input

decision_times.tau: d = tau_d = max(stored tau_ns, the crossing print's own timestamp). Every stored tau_ns in b1 / b2 / S1 is a multiple of 256 ns (float64-rounded upstream, error <= 128 ns either way; T0 measured it before the build); the crossing print = the earliest print at tau_price within 128 ns of the stored value. Inputs b2 / S1 built on the stored tau are then <= tau_d, the crossing print is <= tau_d, and entries (next print after d) are never the crossing print. Wall-clock and volume checkpoints count from tau_d
decision_times.volume_rule: d = the timestamp of the first print strictly after tau at which cumulative shares since tau (prints with ts > tau) reach multiple x ref_shares; ref_shares = shares of prints in [segment start, tau] (segment start 04:00 / open + 60 s / close + 60 s, Amendment 3), the same span as S1's run-up

timing: tau_is_first_print = tau_ns equals the first print at or after 04:00
attention: accel_k0..accel_k4 (b2 count accel, null where the rung is not valid) + accel_valid_k0..k4

log10 pre_trades_per_min and log10 pre_dollars_per_min (D26-collapsed prints at 10 ms; dollars = sum price x size; window = [segment start, tau], or [04:00, tau] for an auction-minute tau; duration floored at 1 s)
flow_share_15_k0, flow_share_60_k0, flow_share_rest_k0 (b2, rung 0 = the whole pre-tau segment window; null where rung 0 is not valid)
catalyst_fundamentals: short_interest_share = R2 short interest / R3 corrected shares count

group_b.window: prints with tau < ts <= d only; the tau print's price is the path's start
group_b.spike_rule: a print confirmed as a spike by d (Brief 1 guard: > 3% from both neighbours, neighbours within 3%; its successor at or before d) is dropped; the last print at or before d cannot be confirmed and is kept
features: high_log = max(0, max log price - log tau price)
u_high = (time of the high - tau) / (d - tau), 0 when the high is the tau price
log10 post_trades_per_min, log10 post_dollars_per_min (D26 collapse, 10 ms)
lr_trade_rate = ln(post / pre trades per min)
lr_dollar_rate = ln(post / pre dollars per min)
accel_post = ln((n2 + 0.5) / (n1 + 0.5)), collapsed prints in the second vs first half of (tau, d]
rv_post = sqrt(sum of squared log changes of the last price on a 5 s grid from tau to d)
max_gap_s (between tau, the prints, and d)
gap_halt_proxy = a gap >= 300 s inside regular hours
vol_progress = log10(shares since tau / ref_shares), null where ref is undefined
z_ret, z_high, z_dd = the move / (sigma_pre x sqrt(elapsed_min)); rv_ratio = rv_post / (sigma_pre x sqrt(elapsed_min))
group_b.noise_scale: sigma_pre = S1 runup_sigma_path / sqrt(S1 runup_minutes) (log units per sqrt minute, from the run-up; null where the run-up is unavailable). sigma_path of the post-tau view is never used
group_b.halt_labels: not used: an external file in scanner-epg-momentum; the tick gap proxy is causal by construction

group_c.path: x(t) = log(last print price at or before tau + t / tau price), t = elapsed seconds; raw prints; NaN past 20:00
group_c.query_grid: t_g = E (g + 1) / 20, g = 0..19, E = d - tau (in seconds); x(t_g) read as the master-grid value at the largest grid time <= t_g (causal)
group_c.typical_path: per type, the pointwise median of the training events' x on the master grid (events with a value at that grid time)
group_c.distance: RMS over the 20 query points of (x_event - x_typical), log units; six numbers per event and checkpoint (dist_<type>)
group_c.stages: per fold: 'tune' (typical paths from the sub-train years, for validation rows) and 'final' (from all training years, for the refit and the test rows)
group_c.cache: results/shape_classifier/s2/cache/ (master-grid paths, ~160 MB; rebuilt by T2, git-ignored in place, not committed)

excluded.flag_cross_session_extreme: A12 flag; T0 documents that it is built from the event day's own last trade (after tau) -- excluded
excluded.competition_excess: uses other names' activity after tau
excluded.post_tau_vector_components: every S1 or b2 post-tau vector component (u_peak, rise_s, fall_s, terminal, sigma_path, jump_share, halt_in_path, ...)
excluded.momentum_pct: D4 (and set from the day's RTH high)
excluded.f1_t0_anchored_fields: flg_dilution_form_before_t0, shs_* as anchored at t0, si_* as settlement-dated: replaced by the R2/R3 tau-anchored versions
excluded.tau_close_sensitive_raw: replaced by the R1 causal state

folds.primary: test events whose ticker never appears in that fold's training years

M4.what: atlas analogs, k nearest training events by the Group C path distance (RMS over the query grid, test event's own E)
M4.candidates: training events with a path value at every query point

models.selection: validation multiclass log loss inside the training window; never a test fold; grid not extended after results are seen

scores.auc: one type vs rest; 95% interval from 500 ticker bootstrap resamples of the test set (seed 20260928)
scores.lift_top10: share of the type among test events whose score is at or above the 90th percentile of that type's score (ties included) / the type's share in the test set
scores.log_loss: multiclass log loss of the model and of M0 on the same test set; skill = 1 - LL / LL_M0
scores.confusion: argmax type vs true type, counts
scores.secondary_labels: AUC of the N = 100 models' probabilities against the N = 50 and N = 200 labels

negative.scope: M1, M2, M3, M4 (both class weights) at every decision time; the training labels (and so the Group C typical paths and M1/M4 shares) permuted within each fold's training window; hyperparameters fixed at the real run's choices
negative.gate: row 2: mean per-fold primary AUC over 3 folds x 10 shuffles, per type x model x decision time, inside [0.45, 0.55]

positive.gated: rule inputs: post100_rise_pct, post100_fall_pct, post100_u_peak (S1 s1_events) added to M2 and M3 inputs at every decision time, real run's hyperparameters
positive.reported: terminal_log (b2 t1_excursion N = 100) added the same way, ungated
positive.gate: row 3: every type's per-fold primary AUC >= 0.95 in the rule-inputs run (M2 and M3, class weight none and balanced)

controls.baseline: M1 vs M0 at tau, reported

money.entry: first print with ts > d (primary, zero latency = upper bound); sensitivities: first print with ts >= d + 1 s and >= d + 5 s
money.exit: last print with ts <= d + h (<= 20:00 for to_2000); d + h past 20:00 = horizon not reached (carried, counted); no print after d before 20:00 = no entry (carried, counted)
units: net cents = (exit - entry) x 100 - 2.512 per share
money.top_decile: per fold, per model variant, per type and decision time: primary test events with the type's score at or above its 90th percentile; pooled over the three folds
money.against: all primary test events that reached that decision time

importance.model: M3 (class weight none, real run's setting) per fold x decision time
importance.method: permute one input column in the primary test set (5 repeats, seed 20260928), predict once, drop in each type's one-vs-rest AUC
importance.share: an input's share of a type's importance = its mean AUC drop / the sum of the positive mean drops over all inputs
importance.row4: share > 0.5 for any type -> LOG row + manual timing re-check of that input

escalation.1: any input uses data after its decision time (T0) -> HARD STOP
escalation.2: negative control (R5 read) outside 0.45-0.55 for any type -> HARD STOP
escalation.3: positive control (R4 gated run) below 0.95 for any type -> HARD STOP
escalation.4: one input > half of a type's permutation importance -> LOG + manual timing check
escalation.5: any fold's primary test set < 20 events of a type (per decision time, reached events) -> LOG; shown, not read in that fold
escalation.6: sklearn / HistGradientBoostingClassifier unavailable offline -> HARD STOP (checked 2026-09-28: sklearn 1.8.0, HGB importable)
